description: This PHP class 'EmpPictureDecorator' serves as a decorator for the EmpPicture entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to manage employee picture data, including retrieving the picture as a string and associating it with an employee by employee number.

classes.name: EmpPictureDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for handling employee pictures, providing utility methods for managing the picture resource and linking it to employee entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an EmpPicture with an Employee entity based on employee number.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Retrieves the picture data as a string, streaming from resource if necessary.
